newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends mostly steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends mostly steady against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed mostly steady at 43.7600/7700 to the dollar on Thursday compared with the previous close at 43.7600/7800, deaders said.
Dealers said the taka opened firmer at 43.7500/7600 against the dollar but later eased as supply of the greenback was tight before the market closed for the Moslem Friday weekend.
Interbank call money rates closed at 6.0 percent to 6.5 percent against the previous 5.5-6.5 percent, dealers said.
